items.author: RobinJehn
items.body:
## TL;DR

Two signals from 21 days of personal Claude Code usage logs across 13 repos (21,089 tool calls, 192 sessions, Serena `v1.2.2`/`v1.3.0`, `--context claude-code`):

1. **Low adoption.** Only **35.4% of sessions (68/192)** use any Serena query tool at all. The other 124 sessions made **1,046 `Read`/`Grep`/`Glob` calls without ever invoking Serena**. Across the whole dataset, Serena's share of all read-class operations is **20.3%** (626 of 3,080). Per-repo share ranges from 0.8% to 58.5%.

items.title: Discussion: real-usage data on Serena adoption and `find_symbol` fallback patterns (n=21k tool calls, 192 sessions, 21 days)

items.title: Feature: add ZCode (Z.ai) as a serena-hooks client
